_comment: [DIST-DEBUGGER-BUNDLE] The single source of truth for which netcoredbg
SharpLsp ships: a release of SharpLsp's fork, Nimblesite/netcoredbg, which
is upstream Samsung/netcoredbg plus the SharpLsp patches on branch
sharplsp/dap-hot-reload (the applyDeltas DAP request for hot reload, and
stepping from a frame without symbols). The fork's own `Build release`
workflow compiles it; SharpLsp never does - not locally, not in CI, not in
a release. Every path goes through tools/netcoredbg/provide.mjs.
CHAIN OF CUSTODY. `platforms` pins a URL and a SHA-256 per platform.
provide.mjs downloads the URL, hashes the bytes, and REFUSES to continue on
a mismatch. A supported platform with no pin is a hard error. The on-disk
marker names the release AND the digest, so bytes the fork re-publishes
under the same tag are downloaded again.
TO BUMP: run the fork's `Build release` workflow (its Actions tab, or
It creates the release and uploads every archive with a provenance
attestation. Then point `release` at that tag and replace every URL and
